housing.text: Hodge wants to invest in a wider range of housing options to make housing more affordable.
housing.quote: That means investing in a diverse range of housing options - from affordable rentals to pathways to homeownership

schools.text: Hodge argues the Department of Education must be preserved to fund public and rural schools.
schools.quote: The Department of Education cannot be eliminated. It plays a vital role in ensuring equitable access to education.

immigration.text: Hodge calls for creating a clear pathway to legal status for long-term residents and criticizes deportation practices.
immigration.quote: creating a clear pathway to legal status for long-term residents

health.text: Hodge says she will fight for a single-payer health care system so everyone gets care.
health.quote: I will fight for a single-payer healthcare system so everyone gets the care they need, no exception

energy.text: Hodge pledges to push for stronger emission standards and federal funding for clean energy jobs.
energy.quote: I will fight for stronger emission standards, major federal funding that creates clean energy jobs in our district

tax.text: He says he is working in Congress to lower taxes to encourage job growth.
tax.quote: In Congress, I am working to eliminate wasteful spending, cut the red tape holding back small businesses, and lower taxes to encourage job growth.

immigration.text: During a visit to an immigration processing center, Obernolte reaffirmed his commitment to lawful immigration enforcement and public safety.
immigration.quote: Rep. Obernolte thanked the men and women working at the facility for their professionalism and reaffirmed his commitment to public safety, lawful immigration enforcement, and accountability.

energy.text: Obernolte introduced legislation to revoke California emissions waivers, arguing that the mandates increase costs and limit consumer choice.
energy.quote: We must protect American jobs and supply chains while preserving the ability of consumers to choose what works best for them and their families.
